invariant: Each component reserves its preferred height, including the global padding contributed by its text block. Group-header reservation additionally includes max(comment text block height - 15, 0); this overflow changes flow but not the tab shape. Empty text blocks carry no padding. Painting uses the same padded text origins and component widths.
causal_divergence: Rust message spacing already includes global text padding, but standalone note flow discards it and group header/else metrics omit it. The group comment overflow rule is absent. With two padded headers and two notes, the missing preferred-height contributions accumulate before return/closing frames; a padded guard may add further height. Tab and label positions also use unpadded block dimensions.
planned_change: Use padded header/tab metrics, padded group/comment text origins and minimum widths. Reserve header comment overflow from actual text metrics and Java's named 15-unit comment allowance. Add note and else padding at their component scheduling sites; do not translate final diagram y coordinates. Preserve message geometry and distinguish empty text from nonempty components.
